assumptions.statement: The submitted overall-design and three key-area boundaries are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry, not official planning polygons, and remain pending professional confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Every geometry-derived area, ratio, partition, corridor, phase, and figure is temporary and unsuitable for statutory, ownership, engineering, or precise-area use.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace the provisional site and key-area polygons when rights-cleared official GIS/CAD geometry becomes available, then rebuild every dependent layer, metric, figure, HTML file, and drawing.

assumptions.statement: Approved Regulatory Detailed Planning controls, road redlines, building control lines, setbacks, height controls, Floor Area Ratio, Building Coverage Ratio, green-space controls, and facility standards are not present in the pinned local package.
assumptions.impact: No numerical development-control value or statutory land-use conclusion is proposed in v0.1.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Reconcile the concept with approved regulatory documents and record every confirmed control with source, date, coordinate system, and professional review.

assumptions.statement: No official existing-condition, parcel, ownership, existing-building, condition, vacancy, tenancy, business, resident, or project-status dataset is present in the pinned local evidence.
assumptions.impact: Personas are design hypotheses; the building layer is a provisional concept; no parcel-level retain, renovate, demolish, acquisition, relocation, or project-status claim is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete rights-cleared surveys and stakeholder participation before building- or parcel-level decisions.

assumptions.statement: No official transport base data is present for exact station interfaces, road geometry, crossing demand, pedestrian and cycling counts, parking supply, traffic operations, or bridge/tunnel constraints.
assumptions.impact: Walking stitches and four-quadrant connection ideas are interface objectives only, not engineering alignments or feasibility conclusions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Undertake transport, accessibility, and safety studies using official base data before selecting an alignment or engineering measure.

assumptions.statement: No official municipal data is present for utility networks, drainage, flood, energy, communications, equipment loads, or network and service capacity.
assumptions.impact: Edge compute, distributed energy, robot testing, stormwater, and shared test-production facilities remain conceptual and carry no load or capacity number.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain specialist surveys and capacity assessments before physical pilots or building design.

assumptions.statement: No complete official heritage or ecological dataset is present for inventories, protection boundaries, historical interpretation, river or blue lines, ecological controls, or park-management requirements.
assumptions.impact: Heritage markers, river-facing public space, lighting, and landscape components are reversible conceptual recommendations only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Stop and redesign any affected component after heritage, ecology, or park-authority review identifies a conflict.

assumptions.statement: No official fire-safety, emergency-access, existing-structure, structural-capacity, foundation, or equipment-load data is present.
assumptions.impact: Test-production spaces, installations, reuse ideas, and building concepts carry no fire or structural feasibility conclusion.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete fire, emergency-access, structural, geotechnical, and equipment-load reviews before site selection or physical intervention.

assumptions.statement: No stakeholder interviews, workshops, surveys, or confirmed operator consultations were conducted for v0.1.
assumptions.impact: Personas, service needs, governance roles, and operating mechanisms are authored design hypotheses, not reported stakeholder views or consent.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Undertake documented participation with residents, users, landholders, operators, public authorities, and affected professional teams before implementation decisions.

assumptions.statement: No operator, public authority, enterprise, community body, funding source, policy package, event host, or Weaving Council has been confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Governance roles, annual rhythms, policies, activities, and implementation phases are conditional design mechanisms, not commitments or observed arrangements.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Confirm legal authority, accountable entities, funding, procurement, operations, grievance handling, and public participation before launch.

assumptions.statement: The twelve AI scenarios have not undergone scenario-specific legality, privacy, cybersecurity, safety, accessibility, procurement, model, or human-factors review.
assumptions.impact: No scenario may leave documentation or a closed sandbox without a purpose, minimum-data inventory, responsible owner, Human Review, grievance, shutdown, and exit plan.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete scenario-specific assessments and record approvals, residual risks, and stop conditions before any public pilot.

assumptions.statement: Named global benchmark cases were not researched in this local-only pass, and the pinned evidence contains no rights-cleared case dossiers.
assumptions.impact: v0.1 provides six transferable benchmark mechanism cards but does not claim factual performance for any named external case.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Add five to eight named cases only after primary or otherwise fit-for-purpose sources, dates, licenses, and limitations are recorded in sources.json.

assumptions.statement: All submitted design layers, areas, and computed ratios beyond announced approximate values are concept-only calculations derived from provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: They describe authored v0.1 design output and cannot be treated as existing-condition measurements, statutory indicators, performance results, or implementation commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rebuild the concept geometry and recompute every dependent area and ratio after official boundaries and professional base data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: The English proposal, bilingual offline HTML, five language-paired figures, and language-paired A3/A0 drawings have been rebuilt and checked for local references.
assumptions.impact: The bilingual artifact prerequisite is satisfied; review readiness is still asserted only through the deterministic manifest, finalize, and self-check results.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: If narrative or graphics change, rebuild both language variants, refresh manifest hashes, and rerun deterministic validation and self-check.
